: wave
1) heap, spring, wave, billow
1a) heap (of stones)
1a1) over dead body
1a2) alone
1a3) used in ratifying a covenant
1b) waves (fig. of chastisement of Jehovah)
1c) spring

strongs_1890.strongs_def: something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves)
